{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Drop QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Verify the drop
print("After dropping QA orders, shape:", sales_clean.shape)"}
